scope: 2019 ATS/ERS spirometry technical statement on acceptability of the forced manoeuvre. Static lung-volume interpretation is not in this document.

keyRecommendations.text: A cough in the first second makes the FEV1 neither acceptable nor usable.
An FET of 15 seconds is an end-of-forced-expiration criterion, with an indicator and a double beep.
If FIVC minus FVC exceeds 0.100 L or 5% of FVC, FEV1 and FVC are not acceptable.

clinicalBottomLine: Do not report an FEV1 from a manoeuvre with a cough in the first second. Use the end-of-test and the FIVC–FVC checks before calling FEV1 and FVC acceptable.
notableCaveats: The 2022 ATS/ERS interpretive strategies document and a static lung-volume standard were not openly available. These questions cover spirometry performance only.

source.title: Standardization of Spirometry 2019 Update. An Official American Thoracic Society and European Respiratory Society Technical Statement.
